## What's Changed **UI/UX:** - **Help links** to the Knowledge Base articles added to every ribbon tool, and ribbon icons added to the five tools that lacked them. - **Keyboard shortcuts** of the tools are defined in items.json now, and the on-screen controls helpers were unified to compact key caps. - The application **warns about known problematic OpenGL drivers**. - **About** dialog: the third-party license notices are bundled with the application and opened from the Credits header. - **Sign in** works by pressing Enter in the Password field, and the password recovery link is localized. - Numerous stability and UI/UX improvements. **Meshes:** - New **Alpha Shape** tool in the Points to Mesh drop list: build a mesh from a point cloud, wrapping the points at a given radius. - New **Rewrap** tool on the Mesh Repair tab: rebuild a mesh as a single clean surface at a given radius, dropping the inner and stray parts. - New **Shrink Wrap** tool: move every vertex of one mesh onto the closest point of another, with an optional offset, to fit one surface to another. - New **Bridge Fill All Holes** tool in the Fill Holes drop list: connect the holes of a mesh with bridges and fill everything that remains, in one click. - New **Clone Selection** tool in the Clone drop list: copy the selected triangles or points into a separate object, which was reachable only from the scene tree context menu before. - **Keep Largest Component**: dialog with a criterion for selecting the component. - **Mesh To Points** covers the surface densely enough to stop any ball of a given radius. - **Fill Holes**: Auto Connect Holes option for Fill All Holes; the point cloud became optional in Fill Holes with Extra Points, which now selects the new triangles. - **Points to Spline** accepts line objects, and subsamples big point clouds. - **Partitioner**: buttons calling To Components and Select Component. - **Mesh Info** shows vertex coordinates, normals and edge vectors in full precision. - **Offset**: Projection Normal sign detection is forbidden in Smooth mode, where it is not supported. - **Pack**: fixed undo of the face color map update. **Nesting:** - **Nesting has its own ribbon tab** now, placed right after Mesh Repair: Build Plate and Nesting left the Experimental tab, and the 3D print preparation tools are gathered there. - **Reset Transformations on Exit** is unchecked by default. - New **Slicestack Diagnostics** tool: inspect every slice of a 3MF slicestack for open contours, intersections and inconsistent winding. **Scanners:** - **Zivid**: the whole chain of causes is reported instead of only the outermost message, and the triangles bridging a depth step are dropped from the captured mesh. **Save/Load:** - **OpenCTM** updated to fix heap overflows on crafted .ctm files (reported by S9S). **Platforms:** - **Windows on ARM** build, experimental so far. - **Ubuntu 26.04** packages, x64 and arm64. - **Web version**: the multithreaded editions fall back to the single-threaded one when they cannot start, and a rare hang while reading or writing files is fixed.
